lines.zh: 我沿溪边走，尾巴扫着地。
lines.en: I walk along the creek, tail dragging.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，草都湿了。
lines.en: The grass is wet where I pass.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子去看那棵树。
lines.en: I waddle over to that tree.
My short legs move fast.
I gnaw a twig as I walk.
I cross the mud and leave flat prints.
I go around to the other side of the river.
I stop and shake my fur.
I follow the muddy bank.
I smell wood.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴一放，坐了一下。
lines.en: I drop my tail and sit a moment.
I get up and shuffle on.
I head toward the fallen timber.
I snap a dry twig.
I take my time.
I squeeze past the roots.
I crouch at the creek without moving.
I rub my forepaws together.
I listen to the water.
My tail drags in the mud.
I look up at the tree.

lines.zh: 我在算那根木头倒下的方向。
lines.en: I am working out which way that tree should fall.
I sniff the air.
I grind my teeth slowly.
The creek wets my belly.

lines.zh: 我坐着不动，像个湿土堆。
lines.en: I sit still like a heap of wet earth.
I take another bite of bark.
I sneeze.
I am watching the fish.
I swivel an ear.
I sit down against a tree.
I wait for the day to warm up.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，鼻尖是湿的。
lines.en: I look up at you with a wet nose.
You are standing at my creek.
I am not afraid of people.
Do you have an apple?

lines.zh: 我把湿鼻子凑近，闻了闻你。
lines.en: I push my wet nose close and sniff you.
This tree is mine.
Do not step on the dam.

lines.zh: 我看了你一眼，又啃起来。
lines.en: I glance at you and go back to chewing.
My little eyes are bright.
Are you here to gnaw trees too?

lines.zh: 河狸的牙，啃得动整棵树。
lines.en: Beaver teeth go through a whole tree.
I roll into the mud.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，水花溅了一地。
lines.en: I slap my tail and spray water everywhere.
That hurt.

lines.zh: 我啃断的树都倒向河边。
lines.en: Every tree I gnaw falls toward the river.
I curl up.
I sink lower into the mud.
I let out two heavy breaths.
I do not much like this.
Apple! I can smell it.
Lower your hand.
I put my forepaws on your knee.
I snatch it in one bite.
This is much better than bark.
I chew quickly.
Is there more?
I nudge your hand.
I will save this and eat it slowly.
You are all right.
I bury the core in the mud.
I sniff your pocket again.
Do not go; wait until I finish.
I am soaked all over.
My tail slaps the water loudest.
I shake water all over you.
This mud is too slick.
We both end up sitting.
A corner of my dam collapses.
I brush the mud off myself.

lines.zh: 哎哟，我的尾巴可不是门槛。
lines.en: Oy — my tail is not a doorstep.
There is another one by the creek.
We go to gnaw that tree together.
She smells of wet earth too.
We gnaw side by side, loudly.
Our tails overlap.
We raise the dam higher.
Water spills around the side.
We crouch on the bank and watch.
At dark we go to our own lodges.
The water holds two reflections.
This branch is good.
I carry it along.

lines.zh: 掉水里的东西我捞起来。
lines.en: I fish out what fell in the water.
I gnaw twice; too hard.
I drag it to the dam.
I press it into the mud.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在头上，稳稳地走。
lines.en: I balance it on my head and walk steady.
Look, I can use this.
You broke my dam.

lines.zh: 我从坝后抬头，牙还咬着树枝。
lines.en: I look up from the dam, branch in my teeth.
Beavers bite too.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，一副要冲的架势。
lines.en: I hunker down, ready to charge.
I charge at you.
This creek is mine.

lines.zh: 你踩塌的坝角，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the dam corner you caved in.
I shove off the dam and charge.
I run after you.
My short legs are not slow.
I bite your boot.
The water makes the path slick.

lines.zh: 我短腿跑得急，一直跟在你后头。
lines.en: My short legs churn, right behind you.
You have backed into the mud.
I wait for you to trip.

lines.zh: 那棵树是我的，你最好绕开。
lines.en: That tree is mine — you'd best walk around it.
My teeth can cut a tree.
I slap you with my tail.

lines.zh: 我低头撞你的腿，牙齿也跟上了。
lines.en: I headbutt your leg, teeth right behind.

lines.zh: 这一下我只用了半分力气。
lines.en: That was half my strength.
The bite makes you step back.
I drag you toward the water.
My forepaws claw your boots.
You would come back?

lines.zh: 我从溪边的窝里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of my lodge by the creek.
Water and trees; this will do.

lines.zh: 我从溪里上来，抖了一身水。
lines.en: I climb out of the creek and shake myself dry.
The new dam starts here.
I bite through the first branch.
I press a hollow into the mud.
I lift my head and smell timber.
The creek has one more owner.
I sit down and get to work.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，我赶紧跳进溪里。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur and I leap into the creek.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，一身泥。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, covered in mud.

lines.zh: 水呛进我的鼻子，我拼命划。
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I paddle hard.
The blast throws me into the water.
A flash of magic and my head spins.
Hungry enough that even bark seems tough.
Lightning strikes and I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，尾巴也抓不住东西。
lines.en: I fall, and even my tail finds nothing.
